basics.name: Yanbin Xu
basics.summary: Final-year Computer Science and Technology undergraduate at the Dundee International Institute of Central South University. Provisionally admitted through the postgraduate recommendation pathway to the direct PhD programme in Bioinformatics at the Zhejiang University–University of Edinburgh Institute (ZJE), under the supervision of Wanlu Liu, with planned research in computational immunology.

highlights: Final-year undergraduate at the Dundee International Institute of Central South University.
Provisional admission through the postgraduate recommendation pathway; anticipated study period: 2027–2032.
